name: Badminton with Pullela Gopichand
line: A private play session and interaction with one of India’s most celebrated badminton coaches.

name: Inside Vinita Pittie’s Haveli
line: A private visit into the designer’s world of heritage, textiles, interiors, art and Deccani aesthetics.

name: Meet Thota Vaikuntam
line: An intimate interaction with the celebrated artist and the stories behind his iconic Telangana-inspired works.

name: Meet Tollywood
line: A private interaction with a leading actor, director, producer or filmmaker from Telugu cinema.
more: Spend time with someone who makes Telugu cinema: on a set, in a studio or over a long lunch. Who you meet depends on who is working and willing.
suits: Film lovers, media and entertainment guests

name: Inside Future City
line: A privately curated look at Hyderabad’s ambitious next-generation city, its vision, planning and development.
more: See the plans and the land for the city Hyderabad is planning next, with someone who can explain the thinking.

name: Inside Genome Valley
line: A specialist-led journey into Hyderabad’s globally significant pharma, biotech and life-sciences ecosystem.
more: Laboratories, manufacturers and the people who run them, chosen around your field.
suits: Life sciences leaders and research delegations

name: Meet Hyderabad’s Founders
line: Private conversations with entrepreneurs and business leaders building some of Hyderabad’s most interesting companies.
more: What worked, what did not and what they would do again, told without a slide deck.

name: Coffee with an Insider
line: One-to-one conversation with a carefully matched Hyderabad expert, from innovation and business to culture, design, food or the city itself.
more: Tell us what you are curious about, and we will find the one person in Hyderabad you should talk to.
